answer: Tie each identity's voting weight to a work bond that only matures after peers audit a sample of its past tasks: the bond is locked, then a random jury re-checks a slice of the history, and a failed audit slashes it. One honest agent tends a single meadow of verified work and passes one audit, while a sybil farm faces an ocean of audits, one per copy, each risking its bond. A mirror check then compares task patterns across identities, so clones sharing the same timing or sources get flagged together and lose every bond at once.
